sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000158-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Lakeside Community Health 158 on July 8, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 290 Pneumococcal doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
